title: Phase-Conditioned Action Contracts for Auditable Microsurgical Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.29426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Staged robotic procedures may reuse a fixed-dimensional policy output even though the admissible motions and physical meanings of its coordinates change across phases. We call this action-semantic shift. To address it, we propose a phase-conditioned executable policy that separates learned action proposal from deterministic command formation. Phase-specific heads generate proposals, while an action contract removes inadmissible components, enforces state-dependent bounds, and decodes the remaining action into phase-dependent task-space commands. We further introduce failure-focused local repair and a read-only provenance trace for exact command replay and rule-level auditing. Across three held-out retinal-injection evaluation blocks, our method achieves $94.27\pm0.64\%$ procedural completion and $64.40\pm2.43\%$ success within $35\,\mu\mathrm{m}$, with no hard violations. translated_title: 用于可审计显微外科控制的相位条件化动作契约
translated_abstract: 分阶段机器人手术过程中，即使其坐标在各阶段之间的可容许运动和物理含义发生改变，也可能会复用固定维度的策略输出。我们将这种现象称为动作语义漂移。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一种相位条件化的可执行策略，将学习到的动作提议与确定性的指令生成相分离。相位特定的头网络生成动作提议，而动作契约则移除不可容许的分量、强制执行状态相关的界限，并将剩余动作解码为相位相关的任务空间指令。我们还进一步引入了面向失败的局部修复机制以及只读溯源追踪，用于实现精确的指令重放和规则级审计。在三个留出的视网膜注射评估区块上，我们的方法实现了94.27±0.64%的手术流程完成率和64.40±2.43%的35微米内成功率，且无任何硬性违规。将契约和解码器应用于相同的冻结Correction网络……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出相位条件化动作契约方法，通过将学习到的动作提议与确定性指令生成相分离来解决分阶段机器人手术中的动作语义漂移问题，并借助局部修复与溯源追踪实现可审计的显微外科控制，在视网膜注射任务中取得94.27%流程完成率且无硬性违规。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes phase-conditioned action contracts that separate learned action proposals from deterministic command formation to address action-semantic shift in staged robotic procedures, enabling auditable microsurgical control with failure-focused local repair, provenance tracing, and zero hard violations in retinal injection tasks.
